faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Everything you need to know about accounts, orders, auctions, and legal policies on iMall.

entries.q: Do I buy products from iMall directly?
entries.a: Usually no. iMall is a marketplace where third-party vendors sell products. Your purchase agreement is with the vendor unless a product is marked as sold by iMall.
Returns follow each vendor's policy. Most sellers offer up to 30 days. For EU deliveries, the 14-day cooling-off right applies where required by law.

entries.q: Can I cancel an order after payment?
entries.a: If the order has not shipped, contact the vendor immediately via iMall messages. Once shipped, cancellation may be handled as a return request.

entries.q: Are auctions available for every product?
entries.a: No. Auctions are enabled per seller and product category. Bids must meet the minimum increment shown on the product page.

entries.q: Do I need an account to buy?
entries.a: Guest browsing is available, but signing in gives you favorites, faster checkout, order history, and easier support.

entries.q: Who should I contact for disputes or data requests?
entries.a: Start with the vendor for order-specific issues. For privacy or platform-level requests, email contact@imall.ge.
